brief: Small-shop profit reality tool that shows true profit after product costs and monthly overhead, break-even unit count, repricing, and dead stock — calculated offline on-device with Chrome Gemini Nano.
criteria: Distinct from blue fintech clichés, instantly readable as M at 16px, works in one colour.

concepts.name: Break-Even M
concepts.idea: Geometric M split by a horizontal break-even datum cut (overhead below, net margin crown above).
rationale: Reads unmistakably as M down to 16px favicon
Encodes the break-even chart directly without stock-arrow clichés
Works identically in one-colour forest green, black, or reversed emerald

recommendation: Break-Even M in Ink Black (#111827) with pure white (#ffffff) reversed on #111827.
next_steps: Copy exports/web-icons/* into Margin-Hackathon/public/ or app/ to activate the favicon and PWA icon set
Use margin-horizontal.svg in README.md and app header
